movie:10384.overview: Set in the 22nd century, when a battered salvage ship sends out a distress signal, the seasoned crew of the rescue hospital ship Nova-17 responds. What they find is a black hole--that threatens to destroy both ships--and a mysterious survivor whose body quickly mutates into a monstrous and deadly form.
movie:10384.tagline: All hell is about to break loose.
movie:10384.title: Supernova

movie:10484.overview: Unable to find her runaway son, a woman deceives two of her ex-lovers from her youth, a mild-mannered teacher and a tough journalist, that each is the real father in order to obtain their help.
movie:10484.title: The ComDads

movie:1083884.overview: A computer scientist is invited by a tech billionaire to join his private facility on a Caribbean island to investigate extraterrestrial matter on Earth. When they make contact beyond our world, chaos erupts as we’re left to wonder: do they come in peace?
movie:1083884.title: Signal One

movie:1127384.overview: A group of international passengers on a flight from Los Angeles to Shanghai is forced to make an emergency landing in shark-infested waters. The terrified group is forced to work together and overcome their differences if they hope to escape their sinking plane and the frenzy of sharks drawn to the wreckage.
movie:1127384.tagline: Surviving the crash is just the beginning.
movie:1127384.title: Deep Water

movie:1179684.overview: After 37 years, the canals of Amsterdam are once again turning blood red. Tara Lee is a young ambitious detective with the Amsterdam police force who is confronted by a number of gruesome incidents around the canals. She enlists the help of  Visser, a retired detective who once nabbed a serial killer stalking those same canals. They face an adversary who seems to possess superhuman powers.
movie:1179684.title: Amsterdamned II

movie:1198984.overview: After a catastrophic military disaster reanimates the dead, Ava searches for her missing husband amidst an increasingly hostile world.
movie:1198984.title: We Bury the Dead

movie:1217584.overview: Years have passed since his last adventure, but José Luis Torrente, the most politically incorrect former cop in Spain, still sees himself as a national hero.
movie:1217584.title: Torrente for President

movie:12584.overview: Afflicted with a terminal illness John Bernard Books, the last of the legendary gunfighters, quietly returns to Carson City for medical attention from his old friend Dr. Hostetler. Aware that his days are numbered, the troubled man seeks solace and peace in a boarding house run by a widow and her son. However, it is not Books' fate to die in peace, as he becomes embroiled in one last valiant battle.
movie:12584.tagline: He's got to face a gunfight once more to live up to his legend once more. To win just one more time.
movie:12584.title: The Shootist

movie:12684.overview: Karl Anton Verloc and his wife own a small cinema in a quiet London suburb where they live seemingly happily. But Mrs. Verloc does not know that her husband has a secret that will affect their relationship and threaten her teenage brother's life.
movie:12684.tagline: A bomb plot... A Killing... Justice.
movie:12684.title: Sabotage

movie:13384.overview: Bullied at school and ignored and abused at home by his indifferent mother and older brother, Billy Casper, a 15-year-old working-class Yorkshire boy, tames and trains his pet kestrel falcon whom he names Kes. Helped and encouraged by his English teacher and his fellow students, Billy finally finds a positive purpose to his unhappy existence.
movie:13384.tagline: They beat him. They deprived him. They ridiculed him. They broke his heart. But they couldn’t break his spirit.
movie:13384.title: Kes

trailer.name: KES - Brand New Masters of Cinema Trailer (SD version)

movie:1356484.overview: At the age of 20, Joachim is unexpectedly accepted into the renowned acting school in Munich and moves into the villa with his grandparents, Inge and Hermann. Between the bizarre challenges of acting school and the eccentric, mostly alcohol-fueled rituals of his grandparents, Joachim tries to find his place in the world — without knowing what role he actually plays in it.
movie:1356484.title: Oh, This Unspeakable Void

movie:1365884.overview: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.
movie:1365884.title: Call My Agent! The Movie

movie:1404684.overview: In 1985 suburban Paris, 12-year-old Vincent lives with his distant older brother and quarrelling parents. Amid laughter and unease, he navigates friendship and first love, while beginning to confront the adult world.
movie:1404684.title: Just an Illusion

movie:14684.overview: When David Greene receives a football scholarship to a prestigious prep school in the 1950s, he feels pressure to hide the fact that he is Jewish from his classmates and teachers, fearing that they may be anti-Semitic. He quickly becomes the big man on campus thanks to his football skills, but when his Jewish background is discovered, his worst fears are realized and his friends turn on him with violent threats and public ridicule.
movie:14684.tagline: Just because you’re accepted doesn’t mean you belong.
movie:14684.title: School Ties

movie:1618784.overview: Li Hongqi is forced to travel for his wedding but must team up with a local cop to rescue a girl from human traffickers, fighting criminals while racing against his wedding date.
movie:1618784.title: Fight Against Evil 3

cast.c: Le voiturier du salon de thé

movie:17684.overview: Choukri, alias Chouchou, a transvestite Maghrebi with clear eyes, comes illegally to Paris to find his nephew. Hired as an assistant by a psychotherapist, known for his good mood, he also work as a waiter in a transvestite cabaret of Clichy where he meets Stanislas.
movie:17684.title: Chouchou

movie:1884.overview: Wicket the Ewok and his friends agree to help two shipwrecked human children, Mace and Cindel, on a quest to find their parents.
movie:1884.tagline: You'll live the adventure... You'll love its heroes.
movie:1884.title: The Ewok Adventure

movie:19384.overview: Jack Caine is a Houston vice cop who's forgotten the rule book. His self-appointed mission is to stop the drugs trade and the number one supplier Victor Manning. While involved in an undercover operation to entrap Victor Manning, his partner is killed, and a sinister newcomer enters the scene...
movie:19384.tagline: Jack Caine. Houston cop. Human. What he's up against, isn't.
movie:19384.title: Dark Angel

movie:2084.overview: John is a mild-mannered banker who has never been lucky in love. Fed up with waiting for the right girl to come along, John takes a chance on a Russian mail-order bride arranged via the Internet, where he is introduced to Nadia. John's fondness for Nadia grows... until the sudden arrival of Nadia's gregarious cousins makes John realize that he's in over his head.
movie:2084.tagline: Be careful what you wish for.
movie:2084.title: Birthday Girl

movie:25284.overview: A devious femme fatale steals her husband’s drug money and hides out in a small town where she meets the perfect dupe for her next scheme.
movie:25284.tagline: Most People Have a Dark Side. She Had Nothing Else.
movie:25284.title: The Last Seduction

movie:298584.overview: While staying at a remote cabin for a week-long vacation, a group of five college friends succumb to an infectious, flesh-eating disease.
movie:298584.tagline: You can't run from what's inside.
movie:298584.title: Cabin Fever

movie:390584.overview: It’s 2006, YouTube is in its infancy, and internet porn is still behind a paywall. Taking the stage name Brent Corrigan, a fresh-faced, wannabe adult video performer is molded into a star by Stephen, a closeted gay porn mogul who runs the skin flick empire Cobra Video from his seemingly ordinary suburban home.
movie:390584.tagline: Sex is not a game, it's business.
movie:390584.title: King Cobra

movie:4484.overview: Two gay men living in St. Tropez have their lives turned upside down when the son of one of the men announces he is getting married. They try to conceal their lifestyle and their ownership of the drag club downstairs when the fiancée and her parents come for dinner.
movie:4484.title: La Cage aux Folles

movie:451184.overview: Havana, Cuba, 1990. René González, an airplane pilot, unexpectedly flees the country, leaving behind his wife Olga and his daughter Irma, and begins a new life in Miami, where he becomes a member of an anti-Castro organization.
movie:451184.title: Wasp Network

movie:45284.overview: When a tough yakuza gangster is betrayed by his bosses, it means all out war. Bodies pile up as he takes out everyone in his way to the top in a brutal quest for revenge.
movie:45284.tagline: One wrong move and it's all out war.
movie:45284.title: Outrage

movie:468284.title: The Insult

movie:67884.overview: A comedy that chronicles a chance encounter between Robert and a Chinese named Jun who wanders lost through the city of Buenos Aires in search of his uncle after being assaulted by a taxi driver and his henchmen.
movie:67884.tagline: An Argentine and a Chinese united by a cow that fell from the sky
movie:67884.title: Chinese Take-Away

movie:68684.overview: As a killer named Cinderhella stalks the student body at the high school in Grizzly Lake, a group of co-eds band together to survive while they're all serving detention.
movie:68684.title: Detention

movie:70584.title: Hellraiser: Revelations

movie:8884.overview: Set between the parallel worlds of contemporary London and the futuristic faith dominated metropolis of Meanwhile City, Franklyn weaves a tale of four souls, whose lives are intertwined by fate, romance and tragedy. As these worlds collide, a single bullet determines the destiny of these four characters.
movie:8884.tagline: Reality is a state of mind.
movie:8884.title: Franklyn

movie:9584.overview: Trucker Rubber Duck and his buddies Pig Pen, Widow Woman and Spider Mike use their CB radios to warn one another of the presence of cops. But conniving Sheriff Wallace is hip to the truckers' tactics, and begins tricking the drivers through his own CB broadcasts. Facing constant harassment from the law, Rubber Duck and his pals use their radios to coordinate a vast convoy and rule the road.
movie:9584.tagline: Ain't nothin' gonna get in their way!
movie:9584.title: Convoy

tv:207484.overview: From the battlefields of World War I to the rugged Highlands of 18th century Scotland, two fated couples must defy the forces that seek to tear them apart, unfolding in surprising and unforeseen ways in this romantic saga that unfolds across time.
tv:207484.title: Outlander: Blood of My Blood

tv:2284.overview: When four pet turtles were bathed in alien ooze, they began to mutate and became the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles. Raised in New York City sewers by their foster father and wise sensei, Master Splinter, Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello, and Raphael wage war against crime. Led by Master Splinter, the four turtles learn the ancient martial art of Ninjitsu, mastering skills of stealth, weapons, and fighting. They stop evildoers in all forms, whether barbaric gangs, lowlife crooks, deranged cyborgs, or even the crime syndicate The Foot, led by their archrival, The Shredder.
tv:2284.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

tv:238084.overview: As illegal firearms flood into a gun-free South Korea, a resolute cop and a mysterious partner join forces to stop the chaos from sweeping the nation.
tv:238084.title: Trigger

tv:2384.overview: Michael Long, an undercover police officer, is shot while investigating a case and left for dead by his assailants. He is rescued by Wilton Knight, a wealthy, dying millionaire and inventor who arranges life-saving surgery, including a new face and a new identity--that of Michael Knight. Michael is then given a special computerized and indestructible car called the Knight Industries Two Thousand (nicknamed KITT), and a mission: apprehend criminals who are beyond the reach of the law. The series depicts Michael's exploits as he and KITT battle the forces of evil on behalf of the Foundation for Law and Government.
tv:2384.tagline: Michael Knight is today's hero! Driving the car of tomorrow! Together, they're the ultimate crimecrashers!
tv:2384.title: Knight Rider

trailer.name: Knight Rider - Show Trailer | NBC Classics

tv:246984.overview: A journey like no other, full of risk and reward. David Attenborough tells stories of dedication, ingenuity and sacrifice as animals embark on an epic challenge – being a parent.
tv:246984.title: Parenthood

tv:247784.overview: A group of ER residents navigate medical crises and personal drama amid a divisive allegation at their Miami hospital.
tv:247784.tagline: Life can change in a heartbeat.

tv:272484.overview: After losing her memory in battle, skilled archer Fu Yixiao is taken in by a noble family and unexpectedly reunited with her former enemy, Prince Feng Suige—the man she once struck with an arrow. As they face the dangers of Yujing together, trust replaces suspicion and a deep bond begins to form. Caught in a web of past betrayals and political intrigue, the two must confront their shared history while fighting for survival, freedom, and each other.
tv:272484.title: Fated Hearts

tv:279884.overview: RAFA retraces Nadal's remarkable journey with cinematic scope, combining testimonies from those who know him best—on and off the court—with unseen moments that reveal what lies behind the legend.
tv:279884.title: Rafa

tv:285084.overview: This tense true-crime series examines the hunt for the Long Island serial killer through the perspective of his victims, their loved ones and the police.
tv:285084.title: Gone Girls: The Long Island Serial Killer

tv:286984.overview: Once a loyal court magician supporting the crown prince from behind the scenes, Alec Ygret is cast aside and exiled for only knowing support magic. But just as he hits rock bottom, he reunites with Yorha Eisentz, a former comrade from the legendary party Lasting Period. Invited to rejoin the team that once made history, Alec returns to dungeon exploration—and begins a new chapter in his life!

tv:291084.overview: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they’ve got.
tv:291084.tagline: Small town doctor. Big time issues.
tv:291084.title: Best Medicine

tv:303084.overview: Filming a daring romance movie, an award-winning actor and an ambitious newcomer lose track of where acting ends and their real desire begins.
tv:303084.tagline: Defy the world, hold on forever.

tv:484.overview: An unassuming mystery writer turned sleuth uses her professional insight to help solve real-life homicide cases.

trailer.name: Murder She Wrote Series Trailer - on DVD

tv:67384.overview: Once a powerful lawyer, Billy McBride is now burned out and washed up, spending more time in a bar than a courtroom. When he reluctantly agrees to pursue a wrongful death lawsuit against the biggest client of Cooperman & McBride, the massive law firm he helped create, Billy and his ragtag team uncover a vast and deadly conspiracy, pitting them all in a life or death trial against the ultimate Goliath.

tv:82684.overview: Corporate worker Mikami Satoru is stabbed by a random killer, and is reborn to an alternate world. But he turns out to be reborn a slime! Thrown into this new world with the name Rimuru, he begins his quest to create a world that’s welcoming to all races.
